This is the CLAIRE case workbench, where you review a downcode reconsideration from start to finish.
The idea is simple. Stay in the record, and let everything else come to you.
Up top, every field on the claim is checked against the record. Green is verified, amber is a mismatch.
The record fills the screen, and each of CLAIRE's findings is boxed right where its evidence appears.
The notepad follows the pages you're reading, so the findings beside you are the ones in front of you.
Open a finding to see CLAIRE's confidence, its reasoning, and every place the record supports it.
Accept it once, and it covers every place. Or just press A.
If CLAIRE missed something, select the words, and say what they are: a diagnosis, a service, a MAR entry, or a note.
And if the text itself came out wrong, flag it, and write what the original actually shows.
To check the source, open the original scan side by side. It scrolls right along with the record.
Or lay the scan over the text, and compare them line by line.
Spotlight dims everything but the evidence. Clean read hides every mark, so you read the record as written.
Full notes puts it all in one place. Every claim line, checked against the record.
And every intervention, with the path from the findings, through the rules, to the result.
Every action is one shortcut away. Press Control K, type a few letters, and go.
When you're done, complete the review with a closing comment.
Stay in the record. Press the question mark in any case for the full tour.
